Aisha: deploybot blocked tonight's change window due to prompt-eval regression: +2.8% (threshold 2%).

deploybot: [automated] preflight-eval: FAILED. metric=prompt_quality delta=+2.8% > 2%. promotion_paused=true.

Tom: Which PR touched prompt processing?

Aisha: PR #9001 by Miguel adjusted soft-truncation for long-context prompts.

Miguel: I trimmed trailing whitespace and applied a soft-cut heuristic to reduce token count. I can revert.

Nora: Product says we should not ship accuracy regressions. Manual override requires product+eng+qa signoff and a documented mitigation.

Priya: Not comfortable shipping. Recommend revert or feature-flag the change.

Miguel: I'll open a revert PR now, should be <30m.

deploybot: action logged: ticket-9001-revert.

Miguel: Revert merged, new canary build at 1749900025. Kicking preflight.

deploybot: preflight started for build 1749900025...

deploybot: preflight result: PASS. metric=prompt_quality delta=+0.1%.

Nora: QA ran a focused sweep (n=150) — looks clean.

Priya: Product approves continuing after revert. Follow-up: reintroduce behind flag with expanded evals.

Aisha: I'll update release notes: "reverted soft-truncation change due to prompt-eval regression; will rework behind feature flag." Closing ticket.
